title: Granular Role Templates & Change History UI for RBAC v2
creator: Asha Patel
description: Problem: RBAC v1 supported coarse roles and ad-hoc member assignment. Customers asked for finer-grained templates, a clear change history, and a console-first surface to understand who changed permissions and when. Scope: design a role templates system and an integrated change history / audit view inside Console that ties to Audit Logs and SSO role mappings. Goals: 1) allow engineers and admins to create, reuse, and customize composable role templates (eg. Billing-Viewer, Model-Deploy, Inference-Admin) with permission groups and per-permission toggles; 2) make member assignment obvious and reversible via a clear modal and inline conflict detection; 3) surface a readable, filterable change history for each role showing diffs, author, timestamp, reason, and linked audit event IDs; 4) include SSO/SAML attribute-to-role mapping UI and surface when assignments originate from SSO; 5) provide primary admin guardrails (warnings for high-privilege grants, require two-step approval for org-level admin changes in enterprise plans). Constraints: must map to backend RBAC v2 model fields (permissions are granular strings like "invoke_api", "manage_capacity", "view_billing"), must reuse Console primitives (row tables, modals, toast notifications), accessibility AA, i18n-ready labels. Success metrics: reduce support tickets about "who changed my role" by 70% in 90 days, 80% of customers adopt templates for new teams, median time-to-assign member < 60s for standard flows. High-level screens and flows: - Role list: searchable table with +/- indicators for inherited permissions, count of members, last changed timestamp, and quick actions (Duplicate, Edit, View history, Assign members). - Create/Edit Role: multi-step panel with (1) Role metadata (name, description, template base), (2) Permission groups (toggle clusters and individual permissions), (3) Inheritance & constraints (lock certain permissions), (4) SSO mapping preview. - Assign members modal: search and add by email, group, or SSO attribute; show conflicts (user already has stronger role), preview effective permissions, and require confirmation for cross-org grants. - Change history panel (per-role): chronological entries with compact diff view (added/removed permissions), author, timestamp, change reason (optional free-text), linked audit log event ID, link to related GitHub PR or support ticket if present. - SSO Mapping editor: declarative rules UI mapping SAML/SCIM attributes to role templates with test runner (enter sample assertion to preview assignments). Edge cases & UX notes: - Overlapping roles: show aggregated effective permissions and highlight the source of each permission (role A vs role B vs template). - Locked permissions: design visual affordance for permissions that cannot be removed by non-admins. - Bulk edits: bulk-assign members and bulk-change permission blocks, with dry-run preview and CSV export. - Audit linkage: each change entry includes the audit event ID; clicking event opens the Audit Logs viewer filtered to that event. Implementation notes for Eng: prefer optimistic UI for small changes but require server confirmation for admin-level permission flips; backend provides role_diff payload used to render compact diff. Accessibility: all toggles keyboard-focusable, diffs have semantic markup for screen readers. Internationalization: avoid compound verbs in button labels, use keys consistent with existing console strings. Deliverables: Figma frames for all screens, annotated components, interaction spec, and handoff token list for engineers. Backend contract doc: Confluence page with expected API endpoints and sample responses.
acceptance_criteria: Role templates can be created, duplicated, and deleted by users with role:create permission
Permission-level toggles are saved and produce a server-side role_diff showing added/removed permissions
Assign members modal supports manual add, group add, and SSO-mapped assignment previews
Change history shows timestamp, author, diff, optional reason, and audit event ID with a link to Audit Logs
SSO mapping editor can accept a sample SAML assertion and preview resulting assignments
Admin-level permission changes present a blocking confirmation and are logged with reason
UI exhibits accessible behaviors (keyboard navigation, screen reader labels) and localized strings

2026-03-04 - Marco Ruiz: Added early wireframes. Prefer inline template selection with an option to 'Save as template' to reduce friction for new teams. See Figma: https://figma.com/file/abc123/rbac-v2-templates

2026-03-05 - Priya Singh (PM): Customer ask from ACME Corp requires SSO mapping visibility and ability to disclaim SSO-originated assignments. Marking customer_impact=high. See Confluence requirements: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/RBAC/RBAC+v2+Requirements

2026-03-06 - Eng sync (with Elena and Sam): Backend will expose role_diff and audit_event_id. ENG ticket created ENG-2147 for API contract. Note: For enterprise tenants we must surface 'approval required' flag returned by backend.

2026-03-08 - Design critique: Tomas (Design Lead) - prefer smaller inline diffs rather than full JSON. Avoid modal depth >2. Consider a 'preview effective permissions' collapse to reduce cognitive load. Action: produce compact diffs and accessibility annotations.
